# Walker Property Services

> Philadelphia property services company: junk removal, property cleanouts, estate and eviction cleanouts, interior demolition, tenant turnovers, interior painting, property preparation, and dumpster rentals (10, 15, 20, 30 yard). Serves Philadelphia — including all of Northeast Philadelphia — the Main Line, Delaware, Montgomery, and Bucks Counties in PA, South Jersey, and northern Delaware. Free estimates; customers can request a job online with photos and get an instant estimate range plus a tracking code.

Key facts:
- Website: https://walkerpropservices.com
- Request a quote: https://walkerpropservices.com/submit
- Email: Edward@walkerpropservices.com
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/walker_a.n.d/
- Customers: homeowners, landlords, property managers, real estate investors and developers, realtors, attorneys and families handling estates
- One vendor for cleanout, demolition, painting, and prep — one call, one invoice
- Before and after photo documentation on jobs; online job tracking

Northeast Philadelphia coverage: Mayfair, Frankford, Tacony, Holmesburg, Fox Chase, Rhawnhurst, Bustleton, Somerton, Torresdale, Morrell Park, Parkwood, Castor, Oxford Circle, Lawncrest, Burholme, Wissinoming, Bridesburg, Academy Gardens (ZIP codes 19111, 19114, 19115, 19116, 19120, 19124, 19135, 19136, 19137, 19149, 19152, 19154).
